sections.Profile:
"Spirit" is a pinball machine released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in October 1982. It has a sci-fi theme with six flippers, two ramps, and a three-ball multiball mode. As part of the Gottlieb System 80A series, it was designed by John Trudeau with artwork by Terry Doerzaph.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1982
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: Alphanumeric
- Players: 4
- Tags: Ghosts, Original Theme, Solid State, 1980s
sections.Design Team:
- Art: Terry Doerzaph
- Design: John Trudeau
- Sound: Craig Beierwaltes
